articles.summary: 在客场击败莱万特后，巴塞罗那队在西甲联赛取得开局五连胜。球员亚马尔在比赛中梅开二度，助球队保持全胜战绩，目前稳居西甲积分榜榜首。

articles.title: Jefferson-Wooden, Bednarek complete Ultimate Championship sprint doubles
articles.excerpt: The Americans won the 100m and 200m at the Ultimate Championship that saw elite athletes win $150,000 each.
articles.summary: 在终极锦标赛（Ultimate Championship）短跑项目中，美国选手杰斐逊·伍登与贝德纳雷克包揽了 100 米和 200 米冠军。每位顶尖运动员由此获得了 15 万美元的奖金。

articles.title: Manchester City wrongly awarded Haaland goal by VAR at United: Refs’ body
articles.excerpt: Erling Haaland's derby winner against Manchester United should not have stood, Premier League referees' body admits.
articles.summary: 英超联赛裁判机构承认，在曼城对阵曼联的德比战中，哈兰德的致胜进球不应被判有效。该进球此前经 VAR 复核后裁定有效，现被确认判罚失误。

articles.title: Tehran and Muscat delay talks, citing regional consensus need
articles.excerpt: Tehran and Muscat agree to delay dialogue to prioritise regional consensus amid tensions in the Strait of Hormuz.
articles.summary: 受霍尔木兹海峡局势紧张影响，德黑兰与马斯喀特同意推迟原定的双边对话。双方均表示，目前优先事项是寻求达成「地区共识」。

articles.title: A third person has died of measles in the US, health officials say
articles.excerpt: Pennsylvania reports that a 40-year-old woman died from the disease, which was declared eliminated in the US in 2000.
articles.summary: 美国宾夕法尼亚州卫生官员报告称，一名 40 岁女性因患麻疹死亡，这是美国发生的第三起相关死亡病例。据悉，美国曾于 2000 年宣布消除麻疹。

articles.title: USA defeat France to win 12th FIBA Women’s Basketball World Cup
articles.excerpt: Breanna Stewart leads comeback win for the record champions despite France's early lead in the Berlin final.

articles.title: Poland, Ukraine accuse Russia of ‘escalation’ after strikes near border

articles.summary: 俄罗斯对波兰与乌克兰边境的一列火车发动袭击，波兰及乌克兰政府对此表示谴责，称此举为「局势升级」。事件发生时，前英国首相鲍里斯·约翰逊等西方官员正在附近。

articles.title: Pro-Palestine protest demands Australia increases pressure on Israel

articles.title: Jerusalem Daily: Pregnant woman killed in Gaza
articles.excerpt: Israeli forces kill a pregnant Palestinian woman in Gaza and settler pogroms intensify across the occupied West Bank.
articles.summary: 据报道，以色列军队在加沙地带击毙了一名怀孕的巴勒斯坦妇女。同时，在被占领的约旦河西岸地区，定居者的暴力活动呈现激化趋势。

articles.title: Can a warming Arctic become an important commercial highway?
articles.excerpt: The conflict in the Middle East raises security concerns about traditional shipping routes.
articles.summary: 随着北极气候变暖，其商业航运价值引发关注。有分析指出，由于中东冲突对传统航道带来的安全担忧，北极航道或将成为重要的商业备选方案。

articles.title: India win Women’s Asia Cup but do not accept trophy
articles.excerpt: India were not present at the trophy ceremony, which was led by Pakistani Interior Minister and ACC President Naqvi.
articles.summary: 印度队赢得女子亚洲杯冠军，但未出席颁奖仪式。该仪式由巴基斯坦内政部长兼亚洲板球理事会主席纳克维主持，印度队缺席了奖杯领取环节。

articles.title: US Envoy Jared Kushner says Doha attack left Israel ‘globally isolated’
articles.excerpt: Jared Kushner, says Israel’s failed attack on Hamas leadership in Doha was ‘terrible’ and left the country ‘isolated'
articles.summary: 美国特使贾里德·库什纳批评了以色列针对多哈哈马斯领导层的攻击行动，称其为「糟糕的」决策，并表示该行动已导致以色列在国际上陷入「孤立」。

articles.title: US will scrap Irish whisky tariff, Trump says
